description: Create ONE custom field definition for items, on a category (categoryId) or org-wide (no categoryId: applies to ALL items). Types: text, number, currency (money amount, numeric value; per-field currencyCode, default = the organization's default currency), date, select (with options), multiselect (several options at once, value = array of option strings), boolean, url (http(s) link). `required` makes items incomplete until filled; `unique` (text/number) enforces distinct values across the organization, e.g. serial or inventory numbers. scaffold_categories creates several fields at once. Not idempotent: a repeated call creates a second field. Requires the manager role.

categoryId.description: Category id — omit for an org-wide field

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 code for currency fields only (e.g. EUR) — absent = the organization's default currency (defaultCurrency in get_setup_status), which is written into the new field. All of the field's values are amounts in THIS one currency; values render code-first (EUR 1'234.50).

label.description: Field label shown in the app

options.description: Allowed values — required for select and multiselect, forbidden otherwise

name: create_field_def
title: Create field definition
